item.title: Re: SCP idea, please give criticism.
item.content:encoded:
I don't know your inpiration, but that concept really reminds me of some mangá/manhwa stories.

I think the problem here is the old shack. It doesnt look like it poses a threat. If the entity is the labyrinth that can make spacial distortions, it could use this to capture people in other places too. Like someone in a library that starts to get lost and suddenly appears in the labyrinth. If you are interested that could be a nice concept in my point of view: a labyrinth that captures lost people.

You could be a little mystery about the entity, or you could reveal why it does that. It could digest the people that die inside it to maintain itself and thats why the changelings try to kill them, or it could extract the vital energy of them, or maybe the youth and you get older faster and faster inside it.

Have a great day! :D

item.title: Re: SCP idea, please give criticism.
item.content:encoded:
I'm a tad confused about why you can't just turn around and exit the basement at this point. If there's some spacial anomaly at play, like the exit disappears behind you or something, I worry that will seem rather constructed and unbelieveable.

Upon entering the shack, you are subjected to a compulsion to decent the staircase that is impossible to ignore.

How do you intend to make these logs not repetitive? This seems like it's doing something similar to SCP-3008 in concept, except the monsters have the abilities of changelings, and I'm unconvinced that you'll be able to tell a story with this particularly familiar setup.

Each log will follow a different D-Class and they will each experience the labyrinth differently. Each one will have separate encounters with the monsters within and react to them differently. In a few logs, the subjects will find abandoned forts, or rooms with anomalous properties or something like that. I'd have to write up a draft and see what sounds interesting.

Additionally do you have any sort of through-line here? Any central character you want to follow or any specific conflict to overcome?

As stated above, each log will follow a different D-Class personnel and their experiences within. As for the conflict, that would be simply the occupants attempting to keep their sanity and not turn on their peers.

item.title: SCP idea, looking for reviews!
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator pitch: An endless labyrinth that translocates people to it seemingly at random occupied by creatures that steal the physical appearances of their victims.

Central Narrative: This SCP is an endless labyrinth that by all accounts is impossible to escape. This labyrinth is occupied by civilians trapped after being translocated inside, and creatures that will eat you and steal your physical appearance upon getting close.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: You cannot trust anybody within the labyrinth as anybody could be one of the monsters posing as a normal human.

Additional Notes: A lot of this will be exploration logs consisting of different personnel's experiences within the labyrinth, and experiencing how the civilians within live on a day to day basis.
